interface.shortDescription: Find jobs and track your search
interface.longDescription: Connect your freehire account to search tech jobs, read full postings, check availability, find similar roles, and compare salaries and hiring demand. Save jobs, track application stages and notes, and manage job alerts. Signed-in tools can change account data and, with your permission and account settings, submit applications. Includes a job-search skill; available tools are discovered from the live server.
